synthesis:draft.headline: VIC1 five‑minute peak RRP = 406.00544 $/MWh at interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (2026-08-20 09:10 AEST).
summary: The VIC1 five‑minute peak RRP was 406.00544 $/MWh at interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (2026-08-20 09:10 AEST).

There were 6 five‑minute intervals at or above the analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh; the first interval at/above the threshold ended 2026-08-19T23:05:00Z and the last such interval ended 2026-08-19T23:45:00Z (2026-08-20 09:45 AEST).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the 23:10Z price peak was 6639.92 MW; net interchange at that interval was -718.24 MW (net flow into VIC1).
Operational demand (half‑hour) at 2026-08-19T23:00:00Z was 6919.0 MW and at 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z was 6812.0 MW; the POE50 forecast for 23:00 was 6550.0 MW and for 23:30 was 6281.0 MW.

The Hazelwood PS 4 6 bus tie outage notice gives 2026-08-20 11:00 AEST (2026-08-20T01:00:00Z), which is after the price extreme interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (2026-08-20 09:10 AEST) and after the last 5‑minute interval at or above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-08-19T23:45:00Z = 2026-08-20 09:45 AEST).

numeric_claims.text: five‑minute intervals at or above analysis threshold
dispatch TOTALDEMAND at price peak (interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z)
dispatch NETINTERCHANGE at price peak (negative = net flow into VIC1)

possible_explanations.statement: Higher‑than‑forecast operational demand around 2026-08-19T23:00:00Z may have contributed to the price spike (compare actuals with POE50).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the full set of pre‑dispatch and operational forecasts against actual operational demand for the half‑hours 2026-08-19T23:00:00Z → 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z and compute forecast errors (use forecast runs and operational demand series returned by the forecast and actual demand tools).

possible_explanations.statement: Local supply changes or generator output ramping may have contributed to the spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect unit availability/outage records and the SCADA time series for the largest changed units over 2026-08-19T20:00:00Z → 2026-08-20T02:00:00Z to determine whether outages or sudden de‑commitments occurred (compare to generation change observations).

possible_explanations.statement: Interconnector limits or invoked constraints (including those referenced in the Hazelwood bus‑tie notice [c1]) may have influenced net transfers and prices.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve constraint binding logs and interconnector transfer limit history for 2026-08-19T23:00:00Z → 2026-08-19T23:45:00Z to see whether constraints were binding or limits were reduced at those intervals; check the AEMO Network Outage Scheduler for recorded start/clear times.
